answer: A sybil attacker splitting into many identities gains nothing, since minting a thousand keys multiplies their locked capital a thousandfold. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to register, and voting power scales with bonded stake, not with the number of keys created. Only an ivory-tier bond unlocks proposal rights, and slashing burns the full deposit on proven duplicate behavior, making attacks strictly costlier than honest participation.
